title: Evaluate NB54361-L as cost-down for PSU-24 Rev 2
description: Procurement proposes NB54361-L (₹190) in place of NB54360 (₹250) on PSU-24 Rev 2. Confirm electrical and thermal suitability for VC-200 and VG-50.

comments.author: Priya Nair
comments.body: Thermal soak per TP-PSU-07 at 70C ambient, sealed enclosure: NB54361-L hit thermal shutdown at 68C under full load. See TR-112 page 4. Not suitable.

comments.author: Arjun Mehta
comments.body: Closing as Won't Do. Rejected per DEC-117. NB54360 remains the only approved regulator for PSU-24 Rev 2.
